repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.summary_zh: screenshot-to-code 是一款 AI 驱动的工具，支持将截图、设计稿或 Figma 设计直接转换为高质量的前端代码（HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue），支持 Gemini 3、Claude Opus 4.5 等先进模型，提供实验性视频录制转代码功能，适用于快速原型开发和 UI 自动化生成。
repos.summary_en: screenshot-to-code is an AI-powered tool that converts screenshots, mockups, and Figma designs into clean, functional front-end code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). It supports advanced models like Gemini 3 and Claude Opus 4.5, with experimental video-to-code capabilities for rapid prototyping and UI automation.

repos.description: 🐹 Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac. Free open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: OCR software, free and offline. 开源、免费的离线OCR软件。支持截屏/批量导入图片，PDF文档识别，排除水印/页眉页脚，扫描/生成二维码。内置多国语言库。
repos.summary_zh: Umi-OCR 是一款开源免费的离线OCR软件，支持截图识别、批量图片处理、PDF文档扫描及二维码识别。具备智能排版解析、水印页眉页脚排除功能，内置多国语言识别库，无需联网即可高效运行，适用于Windows和Linux系统。
repos.summary_en: Umi-OCR is a free, open-source, offline OCR software supporting screenshot recognition, batch image processing, PDF scanning, and QR code detection. It features intelligent layout parsing, watermark/header/footer removal, and multi-language recognition libraries, running efficiently without internet on Windows and Linux.

repos.description: Open source Loom alternative. Beautiful, shareable screen recordings.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款开源的 Loom 替代工具，提供美观、可分享的屏幕录制功能。支持视频录制、编辑与快速分享，采用 Rust + Tauri 构建桌面端，Next.js + React 开发 Web 端，基于 MySQL 和 Drizzle ORM，支持 Docker 一键部署与自托管。
repos.summary_en: Cap is an open-source alternative to Loom, offering beautiful, shareable screen recordings. It enables quick video recording, editing, and sharing via a desktop app (Tauri/Rust) and web interface (Next.js/React), with MySQL backend, Docker deployment, and self-hosting support.

repos.description: A beautiful screenshot + screen recording + Loom alternative - all native, self hostable and free.
repos.summary_zh: Screendrop 是一款 macOS 原生免费开源的截图与屏幕录制工具，作为 Loom 的自托管替代方案。支持全屏/窗口/区域捕获、视频转录、字幕生成、画中画剪辑，并通过 Cloudflare 实现带搜索与评论功能的链接分享，深度集成 Apple Shortcuts 与 Siri 自动化。
repos.summary_en: Screendrop is a free, native macOS screenshot and screen recording app — an open-source, self-hostable Loom alternative. Features include AI on-device transcription, karaoke captions, video editing with zooms and picture-in-picture, smart redaction, and shareable links with searchable transcripts and comments via Cloudflare. Integrates with Apple Shortcuts, Siri, and Finder for seamless automation.

repos.description: 📦 A macOS utility to seamlessly migrate applications to external storage and reclaim local disk space.【一款 macOS 工具，无缝迁移应用到外部存储并自动建立链接，释放宝贵的本地空间】
repos.summary_zh: AppPorts 是一款专为 macOS 设计的应用迁移工具，可将大型应用一键移至外部存储（SSD/SD卡/NAS），并在原位保留极小的启动桩，实现无快捷箭头、无缝启动。具备自动更新保护、代码签名修复、孤立链接检测及数据目录迁移功能，有效解决 Mac 本地空间不足问题。
repos.summary_en: AppPorts is a macOS utility for seamlessly migrating large applications to external storage (SSD/SD card/NAS) while leaving a tiny launcher stub locally. It features arrow-free linking, auto-update protection, code signature repair, and orphaned link detection, effectively reclaiming precious local disk space without breaking system integration.

repos.summary_zh: Snippai 是一款基于先进 AI 算法的智能截图工具，支持公式识别（转 LaTeX）、文本提取、表格转 Markdown、图像分析、代码理解、颜色检测和多语言翻译等功能，显著提升截图处理效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: Snippai is an AI-powered intelligent snipping tool that leverages advanced algorithms to recognize formulas (LaTeX conversion), extract text, convert tables to Markdown, analyze images, understand code, detect colors, and translate text in any language—enhancing productivity through smart screenshot processing.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: 清理Augment缓存和生成设备SessionId/解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件无法登录的问题（Sign in failed. If you have a firewall, please add）/将所有 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 域名统一指向延迟最低的服务器IP
repos.summary_zh: Augment 插件清理工具 v3.4 是一款专为解决 VSCode、Cursor、JetBrains 系列 IDE 中 Augment 插件登录失败问题而设计的跨平台工具。核心功能包括彻底清理插件缓存数据、生成设备 SessionId，以及通过智能测速优化 API 域名解析（将 d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com 指向延迟最低服务器）。支持交互式菜单和命令行模式，提供代理配置、安全预览等高级功能，兼容 Windows/macOS/Linux。
repos.summary_en: Augment Plugin Cleaner v3.4 is a cross-platform utility designed to resolve login failures in Augment plugin for VSCode, Cursor, and JetBrains IDEs. It features comprehensive cache/data cleanup, SessionId generation, and intelligent API domain optimization by testing latency of d1-d20.api.augmentcode.com endpoints. Supports interactive menus, CLI arguments, proxy configurations (Clash/V2Ray/custom), dry-run previews, and works on Windows/macOS/Linux with admin privileges for hosts file modification.

repos.description: Give AI coding agents eyes. Records browser sessions, captures screenshots, collects errors, and bundles proof artifacts — so humans can verify what the agent built.
repos.summary_zh: ProofShot 是一个开源 CLI 工具，专为 AI 编程代理设计，提供视觉验证能力。它通过录制浏览器操作视频、捕获关键截图和系统日志，帮助 AI 代理在无头环境中验证 UI 功能是否正确实现。支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等主流 AI 开发工具集成，自动生成可交互的验证报告，并将结果上传至 GitHub PR，实现端到端的自动化测试闭环。
repos.summary_en: ProofShot is an open-source, agent-agnostic CLI tool that gives AI coding agents visual verification capabilities. It records browser session videos, captures screenshots, and collects console/server logs to validate UI functionality in headless environments. Integrated with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, it auto-generates interactive reports and uploads results to GitHub PRs for seamless human review.

repos.summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
repos.summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.description: 微信输入法（WeType）跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust 客户端
repos.summary_zh: 微信输入法跨设备剪贴板的独立 Rust SDK，通过协议逆向实现文本、图片及文件的多设备同步。提供 CLI 工具 wxc，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，基于局域网 TLS 直连传输，适合自动化脚本与跨设备数据流转场景。
repos.summary_en: An independent Rust SDK for WeType cross-device clipboard, enabling text, image, and file synchronization via protocol reverse engineering. Provides CLI wxc with multi-platform support and LAN TLS direct transfer, suitable for automation scripts and cross-device data workflows.
